column1: # subject_debt_baseline.tsv -- ACCEPTED DEBT: public commit SUBJECTS that carry
# an employer-lane or private project name, or a family reference, which the
# owner ruled on 2026-09-16 to leave in history as declared debt rather than
# rewrite ("declared debt + gate new subjects", desk rows PS/PZ/QA).
# sha<TAB>sha256(subject)[:16]. The subject itself is never stored here: a
# baseline that spelled it would republish it.
# Read by scripts/check_pr_descriptions.py: --history reds on a subject that
# is not listed AND on a listed row it can no longer find; --range does not
# count a listed subject as new. Only the owner adds a row. A row disappears
# only with a history rewrite, which is a council act.
